name: opengecko-market-chart-provider-presets
description: Provider-specific MARKET_CHART_TARGETS examples for source-backed chart and OHLC coverage. These examples describe adapter IDs and request paths only; operators must provide their own MARKET_CHART_BASE_URL and credentials outside OpenGecko.

required_response_shape.provider: string optional; defaults to target provider
required_response_shape.captured_at: RFC3339 timestamp optional; defaults to sync time
required_response_shape.coin_id: string optional; defaults to target coin
required_response_shape.vs_currency: string optional; defaults to target currency
required_response_shape.interval: 1d or 1m optional; defaults to target interval
required_response_shape.points: non-empty array of timestamp and price rows; market_cap, total_volume, open, high, low, close are optional

presets.description: Daily OHLCV-backed chart coverage using a Binance-backed adapter. Useful for high-liquidity assets where market-cap fields may remain null unless the adapter enriches them.
diagnostics: GET /diagnostics/market_charts should move configured targets from configured_pending to live_backed after rows are ingested and should report whether the source rows are fresh or shallow.
GET /diagnostics/ohlcv_sync remains the canonical worker-depth view for CCXT-generated canonical candles.

presets.description: Daily OHLCV-backed chart coverage using a Coinbase-backed adapter. Use as a second provider when Binance coverage is unavailable or for cross-provider spot checks.
diagnostics: Use /diagnostics/market_charts to compare source providers, freshness status, depth status, and latest source timestamps before claiming live chart freshness.

presets.description: Minute-level chart coverage from an operator-managed historical archive. Covers the seeded chart coins as a bounded starter batch before expanding long-tail intraday coverage.
diagnostics: Use /diagnostics/market_charts to verify 1m source rows are fresh enough and deep enough before relying on hourly or intraday chart responses.

operator_notes: Concatenate preset MARKET_CHART_TARGETS strings with commas when enabling more than one provider.
Keep provider credentials in the adapter service, not in OpenGecko target strings.
Run bun run market:charts:sync first, inspect GET /diagnostics/market_charts, then enable OPTIONAL_PROVIDER_SYNC_ENABLED only after standalone sync succeeds.
Use the documented response_fixture entries as offline adapter contracts for daily and intraday parser checks.
